title: Will presidential impoundment authority be expanded by the Supreme Court or by law before November 3, 2026?
rc:
This question will resolve as **Yes** if, before November 3, 2026, limitations on presidential impoundment authority (as first set out in the Impoundment Control Act of 1974 and as of its state on January 20, 2025) have been legally rescinded or modified in whole or in part so as to reduce those limitations. For the purposes of this question, at least one of the following must occur to count as impoundment authority having been "legally rescinded or modified", and must have the effect of granting the President of the United States greater impoundment authority:

* The US Supreme Court issues a decision on the merits of presidential impoundment authority
* The US Supreme Court declines to hear the merits of an impoundment authority case, letting a lower court ruling stand, and Metaculus assesses that the Supreme Court has issued the final judgment on the subject
* A bill is enacted

title: Will Missouri's 2026 Amendment 3 pass, repealing the 2024 abortion-rights protections?
rc: This question will resolve as **Yes** if Missouri's Amendment 3 (HJR 73, 2025) passes in the November 3, 2026 vote, according to the official certified results.
bg: On November 5, 2024, Missouri voters approved [Amendment 3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Missouri_Amendment_3) (the "Right to Reproductive Freedom Initiative") by roughly 52% to 48%, adding Article I, Section 36 to the state constitution and establishing a fundamental right to reproductive freedom, including abortion through fetal viability.

title: Will the Iranian government lose power before 2027?
rc:
This question will resolve as **Yes** if, before January 1, 2027, a state controlling the majority of internationally recognised Iranian territory as of July 1, 2025 meets both of the following criteria, according to [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions):

title: Will the US and China jointly announce a new bilateral trade agreement in 2026?
rc:
This question will resolve **Yes** if a new bilateral trade agreement between the US and China is signed and jointly announced before January 1, 2027. Government officials from both countries must independently announce/confirm the bilateral trade agreement and be published on official government websites (such as The White House and Chinese Ministry of Commerce).

The trade agreement does not need to come into effect before January 1, 2027 to resolve **Yes**.

Amendments to existing agreements do not count.
bg: The US and China have one of the world’s largest trading relationships but do not have a comprehensive bilateral free trade agreement.
